items.title: Free health and eye camp
items.detail: A full day of free general health checks, eye testing and referrals, run with visiting doctors and local volunteers.

items.title: Skills training for women
items.detail: A practical session on tailoring and small-business basics for women looking to build an independent income.

items.title: Tree plantation drive
items.detail: Planting native saplings along the lake road with schoolchildren and volunteers. Bring water and a hat.
